summary:
Prospective independently versioned Host 0.7.0 uses Store14 and the unchanged authenticated passive-receipt ABI, owner checks, correction and canonical-only attribution semantics. Its new package, telemetry-host/v0.7.0 release coordinates and logical journal13 at state/releases/utel-host-rel-13 are distinct from retained 0.6. Current candidate, provider and publisher accept only 0.7, require a genuine new candidate on exact current publisher main, and reject retired continue_failed_original before effects. Historical manifest readers retain 0.4/schema10..12 and 0.5/0.6/schema14; current 0.7 also uses schema14. No common coherent version, store schema or receipt ABI changes.

The authentic 0.6 candidate and original publisher failures remain immutable. The first HTTP422 response and created object identities were not retained. The corrected original exhausted its bounded waiting transitions with journal12 generation2/tag intent still Unknown. Current visibility does not establish no-send or zero effects. A workflow-permission explanation remains inference. The new profile neither recovers, repacks, relabels, resets nor resends the old attempt; a late 0.6 tag cannot satisfy 0.7 or restart a terminal caller. App cleanup logging does not independently establish credential invalidity or feed-key revocation.

Existing protected-main writer, integrity and retired-fence admission precede genesis and every effect. Bounded directory classification refuses unreadable, malformed or changed states; nonforced compare/exchange preserves unrelated directories including old journal12. Current first-attempt, in-progress, expected-operator and exact-main guards remain, with unchanged workflow concurrency. Eight ordered effects retain intent and poll uncertain readback without resend; promotion remains make_latest=false and does not touch the coherent channel. Fresh native admission must qualify both journal locations, destinations, competing runs, protections, writer compatibility and operating budget. Source absence observations reserve nothing and prove no write success.

Future failure diagnostics reuse the common sanitized projection, clearing stale observation state and emitting closed status, request-ID, rate and response-class fields once. Raw bodies, arguments and credentials are excluded. Diagnostic failure cannot replace an Unknown outcome or retroactively establish the old cause. Actual maintained pure controls exercise the publisher with inert providers and disposable Git, eight effects, preservation of old12 bytes, policy drift, terminal caller refusal, old candidate/flag refusal, late old-tag irrelevance and one-send Unknown polling. HTTP/secret/malformed and historical manifest controls remain. The first diagnostic assertion failure is retained; its corrected expectation did not change production outcome semantics.

This is source preparation, not current 0.7 compiled/package/candidate/publication or receiver acceptance. Existing eligible Linux, installed-browser, actual passive correction/restore and full hosted gates remain required. Genuine 0.6 hosted/package qualification retains its original scope. Published Host 0.5, coherent CLI 0.106 and active installed caller 0.105 remain separate and unchanged; only the Host registry source row advances. Home endpoint, trust, service custody, enrollment, backup/restore and adoption remain separately owner-qualified. Source review, safe diagnostics and registry declarations grant no native operation authority.
title: Independent Host 0.7 source retains uncertain 0.6 and requires fresh qualification
